column1: SK하이닉스 어제 체결 중 매도만 보여줘
column2: 종목명은 PRODUCT.PRODUCT_NAME으로 필터한다. 매수는 ORDERS.SIDE='BUY', 매도는 'SELL'. 체결은 EXECUTIONS이고 ORDERS를 거쳐 종목과 매매구분을 얻는다. 어제는 CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY
column3: SELECT e.EXEC_ID, e.EXEC_TS, e.EXEC_QTY, e.EXEC_PRICE, e.EXEC_AMOUNT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE p.PRODUCT_NAME = 'SK하이닉스' AND o.SIDE = 'SELL' AND DATE(e.EXEC_TS) = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ORDER BY e.EXEC_TS

column1: 오늘 여의도지점 체결 건수와 거래대금 알려줘
column2: 지점명은 BRANCH.BRANCH_NAME. 체결 -> 주문 -> 계좌 -> 고객 -> 지점 순으로 조인한다. 거래대금은 EXECUTIONS.EXEC_AMOUNT 합계. 오늘은 CURRENT DATE
column3: SELECT COUNT(*) AS EXEC_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.BRANCH b ON c.BRANCH_CODE = b.BRANCH_CODE WHERE b.BRANCH_NAME = '여의도지점' AND DATE(e.EXEC_TS) = CURRENT DATE

column2: 거래대금, 약정, 체결대금은 같은 뜻으로 EXECUTIONS.EXEC_AMOUNT 합계다. EXECUTIONS에는 계좌나 고객 컬럼이 없으므로 ORDERS -> ACCOUNT -> CUSTOMER 순서로 조인한다
column3: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

column2: 약정은 거래대금(EXEC_AMOUNT 합계)의 동의어. 이번 달은 체결일의 연, 월이 현재와 같은 것
column3: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE YEAR(e.EXEC_TS) = YEAR(CURRENT DATE) AND MONTH(e.EXEC_TS) = MONTH(CURRENT DATE) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

column1: 종목별 체결대금을 시장 안에서 순위 매겨줘
column2: 시장은 PRODUCT.MARKET(KOSPI, KOSDAQ, BOND). 업종 내는 PRODUCT.SECTOR. 순위는 RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY 합계 DESC). 테이블명을 따옴표로 감싸지 않는다
column3: SELECT p.MARKET, p.PRODUCT_NAME, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.MARKET ORDER BY SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) DESC) AS RANK_IN_MARKET FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE GROUP BY p.MARKET, p.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY p.MARKET, RANK_IN_MARKET

column1: 한도 대비 노출금액 비율이 50%를 넘는 데스크 알려줘
column2: 한도 소진율 = 데스크별 최신 기준일 노출금액(ST_POSITIONS.EXPOSURE_AMOUNT) 합계 / DESK.LIMIT_AMOUNT. 행 단위가 아니라 데스크별로 합계를 낸 뒤 비교한다(HAVING). 최신 기준일은 MAX(BASE_DATE)
column3: SELECT d.DESK_NAME, SUM(s.EXPOSURE_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_EXPOSURE, d.LIMIT_AMOUNT, SUM(s.EXPOSURE_AMOUNT) / d.LIMIT_AMOUNT AS USAGE_RATIO FROM FIN_DEMO.ST_POSITIONS s JOIN FIN_DEMO.DESK d ON s.DESK_ID = d.DESK_ID WHERE s.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.ST_POSITIONS) GROUP BY d.DESK_NAME, d.LIMIT_AMOUNT HAVING SUM(s.EXPOSURE_AMOUNT) / d.LIMIT_AMOUNT > 0.5

column2: 고객 등급은 CUSTOMER.GRADE 값 VIP, GOLD, GENERAL. 지점명은 BRANCH.BRANCH_NAME
column3: SELECT b.BRANCH_NAME, COUNT(*) AS CUSTOMER_COUNT FROM FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c JOIN FIN_DEMO.BRANCH b ON c.BRANCH_CODE = b.BRANCH_CODE WHERE c.GRADE = 'GOLD' GROUP BY b.BRANCH_NAME ORDER BY CUSTOMER_COUNT DESC

column1: VIP 고객 중 예수금 많은 순으로 5명
column2: 예수금은 BALANCE_DAILY.CASH_BALANCE. 고객의 예수금은 계좌별 최신 기준일 값의 합. VIP는 CUSTOMER.GRADE='VIP'
column3: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(bd.CASH_BALANCE) AS CASH_BALANCE FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY bd JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON bd.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.GRADE = 'VIP' AND bd.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY CASH_BALANCE DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

column2: 미수는 BALANCE_DAILY.RECEIVABLE가 0보다 큰 경우. 최신 기준일 기준
column3: SELECT bd.ACCOUNT_ID, bd.RECEIVABLE FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY bd WHERE bd.RECEIVABLE > 0 AND bd.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY) ORDER BY bd.RECEIVABLE DESC
SELECT a.ACCOUNT_ID, a.CUSTOMER_ID, a.ACCOUNT_TYPE FROM FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a WHERE a.CREDIT_LOAN_YN = 'Y'

column1: 주문 후 10분 넘게 미체결인 시장가 주문
column2: 미체결은 EXECUTIONS에 행이 없는 주문(LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL). 주문유형은 ORDERS.ORDER_TYPE LIMIT 지정가, MARKET 시장가. 경과 시간은 TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, ...) 분 단위
column3: SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ACCOUNT_ID, o.ORDER_TS FROM FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o LEFT JOIN FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE e.ORDER_ID IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TYPE = 'MARKET' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CURRENT TIMESTAMP - o.ORDER_TS)) > 10

column1: 체결이 하나도 없는 지정가 주문을 종목별로 세어줘
column2: 미체결은 부분체결도 아닌, EXECUTIONS에 행이 하나도 없는 주문이다. NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EXECUTIONS e WHERE e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID). 종목명은 PRODUCT.PRODUCT_NAME
column3: SELECT p.PRODUCT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS UNFILLED_CNT FROM FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE o.ORDER_TYPE = 'LIMIT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e WHERE e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID) GROUP BY p.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY UNFILLED_CNT DESC

column2: 거래대금은 EXEC_AMOUNT 합계. 월 단위는 연, 월로 묶는다
column3: SELECT YEAR(e.EXEC_TS) AS YR, MONTH(e.EXEC_TS) AS MN, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e GROUP BY YEAR(e.EXEC_TS), MONTH(e.EXEC_TS) ORDER BY YR, MN

column1: 고객별 월 거래대금과 전월 대비 증감률
column2: LAG(월 거래대금) OVER (PARTITION BY 고객 ORDER BY 연, 월). 먼저 월별 합계 서브쿼리를 만든다
column3: SELECT t.CUSTOMER_ID, t.YR, t.MN, t.AMT, LAG(t.AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY t.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY t.YR, t.MN) AS PREV_AMT, (t.AMT - LAG(t.AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY t.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY t.YR, t.MN)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(t.AMT) OVER (PARTITION BY t.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY t.YR, t.MN), 0) AS CHANGE_PCT FROM (SELECT a.CUSTOMER_ID, YEAR(e.EXEC_TS) AS YR, MONTH(e.EXEC_TS) AS MN, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS AMT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID GROUP BY a.CUSTOMER_ID, YEAR(e.EXEC_TS), MONTH(e.EXEC_TS)) t ORDER BY t.CUSTOMER_ID, t.YR, t.MN

column2: 실현손익은 EXECUTIONS.REALIZED_PNL 합계(매도 체결에만 값이 있음). 이번 분기는 현재 날짜의 분기와 같은 체결. QUARTER() 사용
column3: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(e.REALIZED_PNL) AS TOTAL_PNL FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE YEAR(e.EXEC_TS) = YEAR(CURRENT DATE) AND QUARTER(e.EXEC_TS) = QUARTER(CURRENT DATE) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_PNL DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

column2: 업종은 PRODUCT.SECTOR. 비중은 업종 합계 / 전체 합계
column3: SELECT p.SECTOR, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT)) OVER () AS SHARE_PCT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE GROUP BY p.SECTOR ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC

column2: 잔고는 BALANCE_DAILY의 CASH_BALANCE + EVAL_AMOUNT. 이동평균은 AVG(...) OVER (PARTITION BY ACCOUNT_ID ORDER BY BASE_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
column3: SELECT ACCOUNT_ID, BASE_DATE, AVG(CASH_BALANCE + EVAL_AMOUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY ACCOUNT_ID ORDER BY BASE_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS MA7 FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY ORDER BY ACCOUNT_ID, BASE_DATE
